_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cave" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "nom" TEXT NOT NULL, "devise" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'EUR', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "domaine" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "cave_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cave (id), "nom" TEXT NOT NULL, "site_officiel" TEXT NULL, "commentaire" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cuvee" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "cave_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cave (id), "domaine_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES domaine (id), "nom" TEXT NULL, "pays" TEXT NOT NULL, "region" TEXT NULL, "sous_region" TEXT NULL, "appellation" TEXT NULL, "signe_qualite" TEXT NULL, "classement" TEXT NULL, "lieu_dit" TEXT NULL, "couleur" TEXT NOT NULL, "type_vin" TEXT NULL, "certification" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fiche_vin" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "cave_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cave (id), "cuvee_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cuvee (id), "millesime" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("millesime" = 'NM' OR "millesime" LIKE '____' AND "millesime" BETWEEN '1900' AND '2999'), "cepages" TEXT NULL, "degre" REAL NULL, "commentaire_millesime" TEXT NULL, "garde_debut" INTEGER NULL, "garde_apogee" INTEGER NULL, "garde_fin" INTEGER NULL, "garde_source" TEXT NULL, "accords" TEXT NULL, "ean" TEXT NULL, "lwin" TEXT NULL, "commentaire_perso" TEXT NULL, "favori" INTEGER NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("favori" IN (0, 1)), "statut_enrichissement" TEXT NULL DEFAULT 'brouillon', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "note_critique" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "cave_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cave (id), "fiche_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES fiche_vin (id), "critique" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" REAL NOT NULL, "echelle" INTEGER NOT NULL, "degustateur" TEXT NULL, "date_note" TEXT NULL, "fenetre_debut" INTEGER NULL, "fenetre_fin" INTEGER NULL, "url" TEXT NULL, "citee_par" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "proprietaire" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "cave_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cave (id), "nom" TEXT NOT NULL, "initiales" TEXT NULL, "couleur" TEXT NULL, "par_defaut" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("par_defaut" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "emplacement" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "cave_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cave (id), "parent_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES emplacement (id), "nom" TEXT NOT NULL, "type_emplacement" TEXT NOT NULL, "lignes" INTEGER NULL, "colonnes" INTEGER NULL, "capacite" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lot" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "cave_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cave (id), "fiche_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES fiche_vin (id), "format_cl" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 75.0, "proprietaire_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES proprietaire (id), "emplacement_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES emplacement (id), "positions" TEXT NULL, "prix_achat_unitaire" REAL NULL, "date_achat" TEXT NULL, "fournisseur" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mouvement" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "cave_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cave (id), "lot_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES lot (id), "type_mouvement" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantite" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(NOT ("quantite" = 0)), "date_mouvement" TEXT NOT NULL, "motif" TEXT NULL, "commentaire" TEXT NULL, "lot_lie_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES lot (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "degustation" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "cave_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cave (id), "fiche_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES fiche_vin (id), "date_degustation" TEXT NOT NULL, "note_perso" REAL NULL, "commentaire" TEXT NULL, "plat" TEXT NULL, "mouvement_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES mouvement (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "prix_marche" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "cave_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cave (id), "fiche_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES fiche_vin (id), "format_cl" REAL NOT NULL, "date_releve" TEXT NOT NULL, "prix" REAL NULL, "devise" TEXT NOT NULL, "nature" TEXT NULL, "nb_offres" INTEGER NULL, "site" TEXT NULL, "url" TEXT NULL, "trouve" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("trouve" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "photo" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "cave_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cave (id), "fiche_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES fiche_vin (id), "chemin" TEXT NOT NULL, "type_photo" TEXT NOT NULL, "principale" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("principale" IN (0, 1)), "largeur" INTEGER NULL, "hauteur" INTEGER NULL, "octets" INTEGER NULL, "chemin_original" TEXT NULL, "cadre" TEXT NULL, "degustation_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES degustation (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "provenance" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "cave_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cave (id), "entite" TEXT NOT NULL, "entite_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "champ" TEXT NOT NULL, "valeur" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "url" TEXT NULL, "confiance" REAL NULL, "date_collecte" TEXT NOT NULL, "statut" TEXT NOT NULL, "signale" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("signale" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "valeur_liste" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "cave_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cave (id), "liste" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "libelle" TEXT NOT NULL, "parent_code" TEXT NULL, "ordre" INTEGER NULL, "actif" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("actif" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "job" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "cave_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cave (id), "fiche_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES fiche_vin (id), "type_job" TEXT NOT NULL, "request_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "job_id_distant" TEXT NULL, "statut" TEXT NOT NULL, "tentatives" INTEGER NULL, "erreur" TEXT NULL, "envoye_le" TEXT NULL, "reponse" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vue_statistique" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "cave_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cave (id), "nom" TEXT NOT NULL, "mesure" TEXT NOT NULL, "dimension_1" TEXT NOT NULL, "dimension_2" TEXT NULL, "filtres" TEXT NULL, "graphique" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "liste_achat" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "cave_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cave (id), "fiche_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES fiche_vin (id), "libelle" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantite" INTEGER NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "achete" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("achete" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX idx_provenance_entite ON provenance (entite, entite_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_valeur_liste ON valeur_liste (liste, code)
